segments.ja327:1.1: Vāti cāyaṃ [vāyaṃ (ka.)] tato gandho, yattha me vasatī piyā;
segments.ja327:1.3: Dūre ito hi kākavatī [kākātī (sī.), kākāti (syā. pī.)], yattha me nirato mano.
segments.ja327:2.1: Kathaṃ samuddamatarī, kathaṃ atari kepukaṃ [kebukaṃ (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja327:3.1: Tayā samuddamatariṃ, tayā atari kepukaṃ [kebukaṃ (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja327:4.3: Yattha jāyāyahaṃ jāraṃ, āvahāmi vahāmi cāti.
